current.messageZh: 火災危險警告為黃色，表示火災危險性頗高。
current.messageEn: The Fire Danger Warning is Yellow and the fire risk is high.

forecast.generalSituationZh: 受一股清勁至強風程度的偏東氣流影響，廣東沿岸明日多雲及有一兩陣雨。預料東北季候風會在星期二早上抵達華南沿岸，該區天氣轉涼及有雨，隨後一兩日早晚仍然清涼。隨著東北季候風在本週後期稍為緩和，廣東沿岸天色好轉，氣溫回升，但日夜溫差頗大。
forecast.generalSituationEn: Under the influence of a fresh to strong easterly airstream, it will be cloudy with one or two rain patches over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Tuesday morning. The weather will become cool with rain over the region. It will remain cool in the morning and at night in the following couple of days. With the northeast monsoon moderating slightly in the latter part of this week, the weather will improve over the coast of Guangdong and temperatures will rise, but the temperature difference between day and night will be rather large.
